AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.description: CAPITAL WOOLS Founded in Riyadh in 1976, it is a leading wholesale and retail company for men's fabrics, wool, and various types of formal uniform fabrics.
AboutPage.aboutText: Established in 1976, CAPITAL WOOLS Company started as a specialized exhibition in the trade of luxurious English fabrics and wool on Thumairi Street in Riyadh, one of the city's most famous streets known for fabric trade. With its long and successful history, the company has evolved to include a wide range of activities in the field of uniforms for various public and private companies, as well as for schools and hospitals. CAPITAL WOOLS Company is known for its comprehensive sales coverage in Riyadh and across the Kingdom, providing various types of winter clothing fabrics, including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and European fabrics, making it an ideal destination for customers seeking quality and variety. Thanks to its extensive experience and successful history, CAPITAL WOOLS Company is considered a reliable and professional choice for all uniform needs, which has made it widely renowned and reputable in the local market.
